scope: Defensive opposing catches observed after release5.1.27; ongoing monitoring, not a final window total.

findings: The requested jump produced observed upward movement; this was not a missed takeoff.
The opponent approached from behind while the local character jumped from a parked position. The sampled horizontal gap was about0.65stud at the local root near its apex.
The native airborne flag became false while physical flight remained true. At that moment the controller logged native catch reach shortened and discarded the old long-hand contact witness.
A later fresh local contact used the shorter native capsule. Possession was awarded to the opponent, and a successful tackle prevented a point.
cases.response: Retain the native-state guard and replan from the actual shorter reach. No input override or speculative timing change was made.
limitations: Opponent proximity and native-state transition are observations; telemetry does not prove the exact native cause of the state change.
A local contact claim is not authoritative possession.
The diagnostic fields prove the initial request was eligible; they cannot establish later native catch arbitration.
